conviction_note: Q3 2026 is new (no ad-hoc or trading update since the 14 Aug half-year report), but the only directional evidence is public: management said in August that utilisation had improved since mid-Q2 and was continuing into H2, and the sector re-rated after Capgemini's 30 Oct guidance raise. Against that, the stock is up about 27% from its 24 Sep low into the print and this name sold both 2026 quarterly prints that met or beat (Q1 -1.2%, H1 -3.0% after opening +3.2%). So p_up stays at 51 and the scaled number is near zero while the findings sum to +0.8. The gap is the reaction-function veto acting on p_up, not on the size. abs_move_pct is 5.5 because the name's observed results-day moves have a fat tail (+21.1%, +14.0%, +12.2% on three of the last ten releases).

already_public.what: FY2026 guide reaffirmed at H1: sales EUR 1.6-1.7bn, EBITDA EUR 130-150m. H1 EBITDA EUR 45.8m, so H2 needs EUR 84.2-104.2m against H2 2025 of about EUR 86m (FY 123.6 less restated H1 37.8). Utilisation 'improved markedly since the middle of the second quarter', 'trend is continuing at the start of the second half'.
Q3 2025 comparator: EBITDA EUR 40.8m in Q3 2025, sales EUR 374.6m; 9M 2025 EBITDA EUR 77.9m

Event date: issuer Finanzkalender lists '11.11.2026 Veröffentlichung der Quartalsmitteilung Q3 2026'. No ad-hoc, Prognoseanpassung or trading update on EQS-News between 14 Aug and the seal; latest corporate item is a board-contract extension, 22 Oct 2026.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 sales about +10-12% y/y (FTE +7% at H1, hiring slowed); EBITDA likely above Q3 2025's EUR 40.8m on the utilisation recovery management described, but Q3 carries none of the extra H2 working days (66 vs 66), so the H2 step-up is weighted to Q4. Mild positive vs YoY; vs consensus unknown.

Most likely reaffirmed: the low end needs H2 below H2 2025. A narrowing toward the upper or lower half is the line that would move the stock; direction unknown, slight lean to 'within reach/confirmed' language like Q3 2025's 'comfortably meet'.

Unknown. Financial liabilities were up 29% to EUR 204.4m at H1, with working capital +22% y/y but only +3% q/q; Q3 operating cash flow and net debt are the line that could disappoint (H1 group net result was a loss).
GenAI order intake (EUR 73.7m in H1) likely updated; the market reads this against the AI-disruption narrative that drove the 2026 de-rating. Direction unknown.

bar: No sourced Q3 consensus (Yahoo returned no quarters; searches in English and German found no Q3 EBITDA estimate). The bar used is the company's FY2026 guide (EUR 130-150m EBITDA, EUR 1.6-1.7bn sales) and the Q3 2025 comparator of EUR 40.8m EBITDA, both sourced above. Every finding is capped small because the consensus bar is unsourced.
session_check: bmo. adesso releases its quarterly and half-year numbers at 07:30 CET/CEST: the H1 2026 release is stamped 14.08.2026 / 07:30 CET/CEST and the Q3 2025 release 12.11.2025 / 07:30 CET/CEST on EQS-News (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/adesso-se-reports-dynamic-sales-growth-of-13-and-a-disproportionately-high-increase-in-ebitda-of-21-for-the-first-half-of-the-year-full-year-forecast-confirmed/818ee8f4-e7bf-4b54-ab69-27a439aa65de_en). The Finanzkalender gives the date (11.11.2026) without a time, so this is inferred from the issuer's consistent pattern, not a timestamp for this release.
positioning_check: Bundesanzeiger register, as of 2026-11-09 per baseline: no disclosed net short at or above 0.5% (anchor_covered false, a truncated zero, so it is not evidence that nobody is short). WorldQuant had disclosed a position above 0.5% on about 30 Jun 2026 (boerse-express, https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/adesso-aktie-worldquant-baut-leerverkaufsposition-auf-923008), and adesso does not appear in the stage's cached German register snapshots from 22 Sep to 10 Nov, so that position has gone below threshold: covered, not building. No squeeze fuel is visible.

findings.finding: Management said at H1 that own-staff utilisation had 'improved markedly since the middle of the second quarter' and the trend was 'continuing at the start of the second half', with new hires 'significantly reduced'. This is the mechanism for Q3 EBITDA to rise y/y after Q2's -9%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 EBITDA beat ('übertrifft Erwartungen') closed -1.2%. H1 2026 (EBITDA slightly above own forecast, Q2 -9%) opened +3.2% and closed -3.0%. Q3 2025 (EBITDA EUR 40.8m, 'comfortably meet') closed +1.6%. Q3 2024 closed +21.1%. Tape: Yahoo ADN1.DE daily bars.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and probably mostly priced: the stock rose from EUR 54.0 (24 Sep) to EUR 74.8 (2 Nov). What is not priced is the quantum, since no Q3 consensus is visible. If the market had fully priced a strong Q3, the stock would not have given back 7% (EUR 74.8 to 69.4) in the five sessions before the print.
findings.independence: Berenberg (17 Aug, Buy, PT EUR 128) cited improving utilisation and the order book: https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/adesso-aktie-723-millionen-euro-verlust-941484. This rests on the same company statement, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: Sector read-across. Capgemini raised its 2026 revenue growth target to 9.0-9.5% cc on 30 Oct after Q3 revenue +11.7% cc, though core Applications & Technology grew only +3.5%. ifo's October survey singled out German IT service providers as improving against a weaker services sector.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No adesso-specific history on peer read-across. The 2026 de-rating (from about EUR 90 to EUR 47.30 low) was sector-driven by AI-disruption fear (stock3, 7 Oct).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: adesso rose through October with the sector. It is a proxy, and macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis; Capgemini's core A&T at +3.5% is weaker than adesso's 12-13%.
findings.independence: ifo October 2026, a different source (de): 'Besonders die IT-Dienstleister entwickelten sich positiv und hoben sich damit vom insgesamt schwächeren Geschäftsklima des Sektors ab.' (IT service providers in particular did well, standing out from the weaker services climate.) https://ms-aktuell.de/welt/ifo-geschaeftsklima-oktober-26-10-2026/ (snippet_only)

findings.finding: Calendar check: Q3 2026 has the same number of German working days as Q3 2025 (66 vs 66, Mon-Fri with no national holiday in Jul-Sep). The '+2 working days vs the previous year' in H2 that management cited all fall in Q4 (Oct 3 and Dec 26 2026 are Saturdays). So the H2 earnings step-up the company described is Q4-weighted, and Q3 must grow on utilisation alone.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The company itself flagged working days in Q3 2025 ('One additional working day in the fourth quarter of 2025') and the stock rose 1.6% that day; no case of the calendar driving a reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Six covering analysts can count working days, so the risk is only that a reader extrapolates the 'significantly higher contribution in H2' to Q3 and treats a modest Q3 as a miss. This is inference from the calendar plus the company's statement, so it is sized small.

findings.finding: Supervisory board chair and roughly 27% holder Volker Gruhn told the F.A.Z. that adesso is currently generating more new business than AI is taking away, while conceding 'Ob das auf Dauer so bleibt, kann ich noch nicht sagen'. The stock rose about 6% that day on heavy volume.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 7 Oct 2026 close +6.2% (EUR 58.5 to 62.1, volume 28.9k against about 6k a day), the start of the October rally.
findings.original_quote: in seinem Unternehmen entstehe derzeit mehr zusätzliches Geschäft, als durch KI wegfalle. ... "Ob das auf Dauer so bleibt, kann ich noch nicht sagen." (his company is currently generating more additional business than AI takes away ... 'Whether that stays so in the long run, I cannot yet say.')
findings.why_not_priced: Already reacted to (+6% that day). What it adds is an insider's qualitative read on demand during Q3/Q4, which the release can confirm through order intake. Mostly priced.
findings.independence: GenAI order intake of EUR 73.7m in H1 from the company's own release (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/adesso-se-reports-dynamic-sales-growth-of-13-and-a-disproportionately-high-increase-in-ebitda-of-21-for-the-first-half-of-the-year-full-year-forecast-confirmed/818ee8f4-e7bf-4b54-ab69-27a439aa65de_en)

findings.finding: Contract flow during Q3/Q4: SECO EasyGov platform (1 Sep), and in October a five-year framework agreement with the PKV association to run and develop VSDM 2.0 on StackIT.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Contract announcements have not moved the stock measurably (12 Aug omni:us acquisition day -2.15%).
findings.why_not_priced: Public and small against a EUR 1.6bn revenue base, so it barely bears on Q3 numbers. Included only as order-intake support.

findings.finding: The only disclosed short (WorldQuant, above 0.5%, around 30 Jun 2026) is no longer on the register, so there is no squeeze fuel and no building short into the print.
findings.original_quote: WorldQuant, LLC überschritt die Meldeschwelle von 0,5 Prozent des Aktienkapitals ... das erste offizielle Short-Engagement bei Adesso überhaupt. (WorldQuant crossed the 0.5% reporting threshold ... the first official short position in adesso ever.)
findings.why_not_priced: Neutral by construction: it tells the reader there is no visible positioning to beat in either direction.

findings.finding: Balance sheet into Q3: financial liabilities were up 29% to EUR 204.4m at H1, the H1 group net result was a loss (about EUR -7.2m per media), and there was a EUR 2.1m material.one goodwill write-down. Working capital, though, rose only 3% q/q, which management called a 'gradual normalisation of pre-financing'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026 (net loss, debt up) opened +3.2% and closed -3.0%; it is not separable from the Q2 EBITDA miss.
findings.why_not_priced: The debt funds working capital for public-sector general-contractor work (pre-financing), which is growth, not distress. The sign hinges on Q3 cash conversion, which is unknown, so the finding is near zero.
findings.independence: boerse-express on the H1 loss (de): 'Unter dem Strich verzeichnete Adesso für die ersten sechs Monate des Jahres einen Verlust von 7,23 Millionen Euro.' (Bottom line, adesso recorded a loss of EUR 7.23m for the first six months.) https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/adesso-aktie-723-millionen-euro-verlust-941484

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive and agree with the 60-day run-up (+16.4%) and the October sector re-rating, so they are largely priced. They cut against the 5-day pullback (-4.2%) and the slightly negative priced lean (-0.16), and this name's habit of selling met-or-beaten prints in 2026 pulls p_up back to about 50.
language_note: German press (stock3, 7 Oct) carried the supervisory-board chair's F.A.Z. comment on AI demand ('mehr zusätzliches Geschäft, als durch KI wegfalle') and his caveat; English sources did not carry it.
German press (boerse-express, 30 Jun) carried the WorldQuant >0.5% short disclosure; its later absence from the register is what establishes the short was covered.
German sources carried the ifo October read that IT service providers improved against the services sector, and the PKV/VSDM 2.0 framework contract.
The issuer's German Finanzkalender page answered (the English one 404s) and is what confirmed 11.11.2026.
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move / size on what is new': Q3 is new and not pre-released and the name's observed results-day tail is fat, so abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.5; p_up was unchanged
'A narrow proxy loses / macro transmission is a hypothesis': the Capgemini/ifo sector finding went from +0.4 to +0.3
'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number': the working-day finding is my own inference and analysts can count days, so it went from -0.3 to -0.2
'A German ad-hoc may have pre-released the number': checked, and there is none since 14 Aug, so no change
'Cash can outweigh a raised guide': kept the financing/working-capital finding and named cash flow as a new_in_release line; size unchanged
